versions.changelog:
nano-banana-pro v1.0.0

- Initial release of nano-banana-pro skill.
- Generate and edit images using Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image).
- Access to 50+ models for image, video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS.
- Unified API key usage across multiple providers like Bedrock, OpenAI, Vertex, ElevenLabs, Replicate, and more.
- Smart routing to auto-select the best-suited model for any supported task.
